title: NIH MULTIPLE-AWARD CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT (MACC) FOR GENERAL CONSTRUCTION SERVICES
description: PRESOLICITATION NOTICE MULTIPLE-AWARD CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT (MACC) FOR GENERAL CONSTRUCTION SERVICES Solicitation No. 75N99027R00002 The Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), National Institutes of Health (NIH), Office of Acquisition and Logistics Management (OALM), Construction, A&E, Facilities and Leasing Office (CAFLO), anticipates issuing a Request for Proposals (RFP) for a Multiple-Award Construction Contract (MACC) to support the ongoing construction, alteration, repair, and maintenance requirements of the NIH Office of Research Facilities (ORF). The resulting contracts will be multiple-award Indefinite-Delivery, Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) construction contracts. Work will be authorized through individually issued task orders. This acquisition is anticipated to be conducted using competitive negotiated procedures under FAR Part 15. The Government intends to award multiple IDIQ construction contracts under FAR Subpart 16.5. Individual task orders will generally be awarded on a firm-fixed-price basis. The anticipated aggregate ceiling is $3 billion over an eight-year ordering period. Individual construction requirements will be competed through task orders among eligible MACC awardees in accordance with the ordering procedures established in the resulting contracts. The solicitation and resulting contracts will include procedures for adding and removing awardees during that period (on/off ramp). The initial seed-project scope estimated construction magnitude, applicable evaluation factors, and proposal submission requirements will be provided in the solicitation. SCOPE OF WORK Work under the MACC will primarily consist of general construction and may include, but is not limited to, maintenance, repair, painting, alterations, architectural work, mechanical systems, electrical systems, plumbing, heating, ventilation and air-conditioning (HVAC), civil work, earthwork, fencing, structural work, steel fabrication and welding, roofing, building renovations, demolition, new building construction, sustainable construction, design-bid-build, and design-build projects. Individual task orders may include one or more construction disciplines and will vary in size, scope, and complexity. All work will be performed in accordance with the requirements, specifications, drawings, and other documents applicable to each individual task order. LOCATIONS OF WORK The National Institutes of Health (NIH), Office of Research Facilities (ORF) is the steward of NIH facilities and is responsible for the planning, design, construction, acquisition, maintenance and operation of NIH owned facilities, which include campuses in: � Bethesda, Maryland, � Frederick, Maryland, � Poolesville, Maryland, � Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, � The Rocky Mountain Laboratories (RML) in Hamilton, Montana. NAICS CODE AND SMALL BUSINESS SIZE STANDARD The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this acquisition is 236220, Commercial and Institutional Building Construction. PSC Code: Y1JZ The corresponding small business size standard is $45 million. The NAICS code and small business size standard applicable to the initial seed project is also anticipated to be NAICS 236220 and $45 million, respectively. ACQUISITION STRATEGY AND ANTICIPATED AWARDS This acquisition will be conducted using full and open competition with reserves for eligible small business concerns. NIH anticipates awarding up to twenty (20) IDIQ contracts, consisting of: Approximately four (4) unrestricted/full-and-open awards; and Approximately sixteen (16) awards under small business reserves. The small business reserves are anticipated to include eligible concerns in the following categories: Historically Underutilized Business Zone (HUBZone) Small Business; Women-Owned Small Business (WOSB); Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB); and Participants in the SBA 8(a) Business Development Program. The solicitation will identify the anticipated distribution of the sixteen (16) reserve awards among the applicable small business and socioeconomic categories and will establish the eligibility requirements applicable to each reserve. NIH anticipates approximately four (4) awards in each socioeconomic reserve. Offerors must meet all applicable SBA eligibility requirements for the category under which they submit an offer. BONDING CAPACITY Offerors competing for an unrestricted/full-and-open award shall provide evidence from their surety demonstrating, at a minimum, bonding capacity of: $100 million for a single project; and $300 million aggregate bonding capacity. Offerors competing for an award under a small business reserve shall provide evidence from their surety demonstrating, at a minimum, bonding capacity of: $3 million for a single project; and $10 million aggregate bonding capacity. The solicitation will establish the specific documentation required to demonstrate bonding capacity. Performance and payment bond requirements applicable to individual construction task orders will be established in accordance with the solicitation, resulting contracts, applicable law and regulation, and the requirements of each task order. SMALL BUSINESS ELIGIBILITY AND JOINT VENTURES Offerors seeking an award under a small business reserve must satisfy all applicable SBA eligibility requirements for the applicable reserve category and NAICS code. The solicitation will identify any documentation required to establish an offeror's eligibility for the applicable small business or socioeconomic category. Small business concerns intending to submit an offer as a joint venture must comply with all applicable SBA joint venture requirements, including applicable requirements governing SBA-approved Mentor-Prot�g� relationships. Prospective offerors should consult current SBA regulations and guidance concerning joint ventures and the SBA Mentor-Prot�g� Program at www.sba.gov. CONTRACT CEILING AND ORDERING PERIOD The aggregate maximum value of all contracts and task orders awarded under the MACC will not exceed $3,000,000,000.00 over the entire ordering period. The $3 billion ceiling applies collectively to all MACC contracts and is not a per-contractor ceiling. The anticipated ordering period will consist of one eight-year ordering period. There is no anticipated annual or individual-contractor ceiling other than limitations established by the terms of the resulting contracts and individual task orders. MACC holders will remain eligible to compete for task orders, subject to the terms and conditions of their contracts, until expiration of the ordering period or exhaustion of the aggregate MACC ceiling, whichever occurs first. TASK ORDERS All work under the MACC will be authorized through individual task orders. Individual task orders will generally be awarded on a firm-fixed-price basis and will be separately priced. Each task order will establish the applicable scope of work, specifications and drawings, period of performance, applicable wage determination, bonding requirements, and other project-specific requirements. Task orders may be competed among all eligible MACC holders or restricted to eligible small business MACC holders in accordance with the ordering procedures established in the solicitation and resulting contracts. The anticipated maximum value of an individual task order is $800 million. Eligibility to compete for individual task orders may be subject to project-specific requirements, including required bonding capacity. GUARANTEED MINIMUM The Government's guaranteed minimum under each resulting IDIQ contract will be $1,000. The guaranteed minimum will be satisfied through issuance of a task order. The $1,000 guaranteed minimum is a contractual minimum obligation and should not be interpreted as establishing the minimum dollar value of all future task orders. title: Spain – Building construction work – Concesión de obra, para la redacción del proyecto y dirección facultativa, construcción y explotación del Palacio de Congresos y Exposiciones de Madrid
description: En el marco de las competencias que tiene atribuidas Turespaña ha obtenido la autorización del Consejo de Ministros para licitar la concesión de obra pública del Palacio de congresos de Madrid, en la reunión celebrada el 6 de mayo de 2025. El complejo va a ser objeto de una rehabilitación integral que comenzó ya en 2023 con la obra de remodelación y ampliación del Edificio B para convertirse en la futura sede de Onu-Turismo. La nueva licitación tiene por objeto la concesión de obra pública del resto de inmuebles que integran el complejo. El adjudicatario se encargará de redactar el proyecto de ejecución, realizar las obras y explotar el Palacio de Congresos y su aparcamiento por un plazo de concesión de 40 años a cambio de un canon anual que abonará a Turespaña. El plazo de la concesión es de 40 años, incluyendo una fase de redacción de proyecto de ejecución y obra de 48 meses. El CAPEX es de 105,7 Millones de euros, y la TIR de proyecto de 7,65%. Una vez completados todos los trámites administrativos, Turespaña publicará la licitación en la Plataforma de Contratación del Sector Público y el Diario Oficial de la Unión Europa (DOUE). Los interesados en la licitación pueden consultar la documentación relativa al estudio de viabilidad y anteproyecto y proyecto básico en el Portal de Transparencia de Turespaña.

title: Slovakia – Miscellaneous special-purpose machinery – Výstavba lanovej dráhy na Martinské hole
description: Predmetom zákazky je výstavba 8-miestnej kabínkovej lanovej dráhy na Martinské hole s celoročným využitím vrátane súvisiacej technickej infraštruktúry priamo spojenej s jej prevádzkou, najmä prípojok inžinierskych sietí. Predmet zákazky pozostáva z technologickej a stavebnej časti odpojiteľnej jednolanovej obežnej lanovej dráhy s 8-miestnymi kabínami s úrovňovým nástupom, údolnej a vrcholovej stanice vrátane sociálneho zázemia pre pracovníkov obsluhy a súvisiacej inžinierskej činnosti. Súčasťou predmetu zákazky je aj vypracovanie realizačnej dokumentácie, dokumentácie skutočného vyhotovenia stavby v rozsahu potrebnom na kolaudáciu a riadne užívanie stavby, ako aj vypracovanie a odovzdanie prevádzkových predpisov, predpisov pre obsluhu, údržbu, vykonávanie skúšok a technickej dokumentácie elektrických a hydraulických prvkov v slovenskom jazyku. Požadovaná kabínková lanovka musí byt’ nová, nepoužívaná, nerepasovaná (ďalej aj ako „predmet zákazky“). Podrobné vymedzenie predmetu zákazky je uvedené vo Zväzku 3 Opis predmetu zákazky súťažných podkladov.

title: Ukraine – Railway and tramway passenger coaches, and trolleybuses – Supply of new Metro trainsets, 5 coaches each, including spare parts and consumables, equipment and tools for maintenance, repair and related services, up to a total budget of euro 45 (forty five) million, sales taxes and customs duties excluded
description: Supply of new Metro trainsets, 5 coaches each, associated goods and related services includes the supply of the following: - Metro trainsets, 5 coaches each, - Main spare parts, - Trainsets maintenance and repair equipment and tools, - Consumable and wearable spare parts, - Documentation in paper form and on electronic media, - Commissioning of metro train sets and ancillary equipment (including installation, if needed), - Personnel training. INCOTERMS Delivery conditions: The price of the Goods shall be quoted on the basis of the edition 2020 of INCOTERMS delivery terms, (published by the International Chamber of Commerce, Paris) EXW for Goods to be supplied from within the Contracting Authority’s country and CIP for Goods to be supplied from outside the Contracting Authority’s country excluding VAT. All detailed technical and functional specifications, descriptions, characteristics, Drawings are available in the tender documentation. Tender Document is available for free and is provided to the tenderers in format .pdf electronically via Tenderer’s request by means of provision to the stage to the cloud storage or by e-mail. Tenderer’s request shall be issued on the letterhead of the Tenderer and obligatory contain the name of Tenderer, name of the project, name of the tender, and identification number of tender, country of origin of the tenderer, e-mail address, phone number, and name of the responsible person(s). • In line with cl. 19.1 of the section II Tender Data Sheet (TDS) of the Tender Document, the amount and currency of the tender security shall be EUR 1,000,000.00 (one million euros) or the equivalent amount in another freely convertible currency or in the Ukrainian Hryvnia, determined at the official rate(s) of the Ukrainian Hryvnia against foreign currencies established by the National Bank of Ukraine as of the date of the tender security is issued and must be submitted at the address indicated below no later than the time and date of the deadline for tender submission. All Tenders must be delivered in closed envelopes bearing the mention “Supply of new Metro trainsets, 5 coaches each, including spare parts and consumables, equipment and tools for maintenance, repair and related services, up to a total budget of euro 45 (forty five) million, sales taxes and customs duties excluded” to the office at the address below on or before on 15 December 2026 at 13:00 (local time). Tenders will be opened immediately in the presence of Tenderers’ representatives who choose to attend.

title: NGA - Boosting Innovative GEOINT - Science & Technology Broad Agency Announcement (BIG-ST BAA)

title: Z1DA--FY27 Danville Mechanical MATOC SEED PROJECT NO: 550-26-106, Replace Air Handling Unit B58 at the VA Illiana Health Care System (VIHCS), Danville IL.
description: Presolicitation Notice Presolicitation Notice Page 3 of 4 Presolicitation Notice *=Required Field Presolicitation Notice Page 1 of 4 DESCRIPTION PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE: The VA Illiana Health Care System (VIHCS), Danville IL, 1900 E Main St. Danville, IL 61832, has a need for a Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC) for mechanical construction. The VA intends to award a MATOC for mechanical maintenance, repair, alteration, and repair of buildings and other real property belonging to this facility, with task orders ranging in value from $2,000 to $3,000,000. The maximum net value of all task orders and modifications, combined for all contractors issued under this MATOC shall not exceed $20 Million. The net aggregate value for the individualized contractor for all task orders and modifications issued against the MATOC shall not exceed $19 Million. The MATOC will include a five (5) year ordering period from date of award. The VA anticipates a minimum of two (2) IDIQ contract awards and shall reserve the right to make additional IDIQ awards. The primary purpose/work to be ordered under this contract is mechanical construction (NAICS 238220) but may include work incidental to the overall construction work, such as carpentry; asphalt and concrete paving; roofing; excavation; interior renovation; carpet, window, door installation; mechanical; electrical; plumbing; painting and stucco; demolition; masonry; fire protection; telecommunications; HVAC; and other construction-related work. As project requirements are defined, individual task order solicitations will be competitively issued to all selected MATOC contractors. The NAICS code for this procurement is 238220 with a size standard of $19.0 Million Dollars. The construction range for the seed project is between $1,000,000 and $2,000,000. Contractors will be required under the contract to have a minimum individual task order bonding capacity of $2,000,000 for the life of the contract. This acquisition shall be 100% set-aside for Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SBVOSB) concerns per the authority of 38 U.S.C. 8127 (Public Law 109-461). In accordance with VAAR 819.7003(b), at the time of submission of proposal, the offeror must represent that is a SDVOSB concern, a small business concern under the NAICS code assigned to the acquisition, and has a SBA SDVOSB Certification Veteran Small Business Certification (www.sba.gov). This Pre-Solicitation notice is NOT a request for proposals or submittals of any kind. The VA plans to issue the official solicitation 36C25227R0002 on or about 11/20/2026. The solicitation will be posted to https://www.SAM.gov.

description: Muutosturvakoulutusten pienhankintarekisteri, uusi ilmoitus Business Oulu -liikelaitos (jäljempänä myös "BusinessOulu", "Tilaaja" ja "Hankintayksikkö") pyytää tarjouksia Oulun seudun työllisyysalueella järjestettävistä muutosturvakoulutuksista (jäljempänä myös "muutosturva55+ -koulutus") tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Oulun seudun työllisyysalueeseen kuuluvat seuraavat kunnat Hailuoto, Ii, Kempele, Liminka, Lumijoki, Muhos, Oulu, Pudasjärvi, Tyrnävä, Utajärvi ja Vaala. Business Oulu -liikelaitoksen työllisyysjaosto on Oulun kaupungin organisaatioon kuuluva toimielin, joka vastaa työvoimapalvelujen järjestämisestä Oulun seudun työllisyysalueella. Hankinnalla perustetaan dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän toimintamalliin pohjautuva pienhankintarekisteri, johon hyväksytään kaikki tarjouspyynnön soveltuvuusvaatimukset ja tarjouspyynnössä esitetyt muut kriteerit täyttävät tarjoajat. Muutosturvakoulutuksella tuetaan työstään tuotannollisella tai taloudellisella perusteella irtisanottujen 55 vuotta täyttäneiden henkilöiden nopeaa uudelleen työllistymistä parantamalla heidän ammatillista osaamistaan tai yrittäjävalmiuksiaan. Muutosturvakoulutuksia säädellään julkisesta työvoima- ja yrityspalvelusta annetun lain 5a luvussa (916/2012). Pienhankintarekisteristä voidaan hankkia palveluita suoraan rekisteriin hyväksytyltä toimijalta tai kilpailuttamalla nopeutetulla aikataululla joko rajoitetulla menettelyllä tai kaikilta rekisteriin hyväksytyiltä tarjoajilta Hankinnasta kiinnostuneita ehdokkaita pyydetään jättämään osallistumishakemus Tarjouspalvelu.fi-portaalissa tämän osallistumispyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Hankinnasta julkaistaan tämä uusi ilmoitus teknisen virheen vuoksi. Edellinen ilmoitus avattiin hankintailmoitus 11.3.2025 ja siihen hyväksymispäätöksen (§49/2025, toimitettu 16.4.2025) saaneiden tarjoajien ei tarvitse jättää uutta osallistumisilmoitusta,

description:
Le projet N01/42, 46 échang. ZH-Nord – échang. ZH-Est – échang. Brüttisellen (forme abrégée : PZO) prévoit la réduction des goulets d’étranglement existants au niveau de l’échangeur de Brüttisellen jusqu’à l’échangeur de Zurich Est, ainsi que l’amélioration de la fluidité du trafic. À cette fin, il est prévu de mettre en place une réaffectation permanente de la bande d’arrêt d’urgence (R-BAU) et de réaliser diverses mesures d’aménagement sur le tracé, les ouvrages d’art et les portiques de signalisation, y c. les équipements d’exploitation et de sécurité. D’autres éléments du projet sont l’assainissement du bruit (construction de 5 PAB, remplacement d’une PAB) et le traitement des eaux de chaussée (construction de 2 SABA).

Le présent mandat relatif aux travaux principaux du lot 7.1 Installation de câbles du projet EES (TP EES lot 7.1 EL-KAB) comprend les principales prestations suivantes :

  • Raccordement par câble SABA / station de pompage pour surveillance par installation DIV
  • Raccordement par câbles de nouveaux portails EDT
  • Raccordement par câbles de nouveaux portiques de signalisation à partir des QSK
  • Raccordement par câbles de nouveaux PMV
  • Étiquetage des câbles selon l’AKS-CH
  • Raccordement par câbles des coffrets de distribution vidéo pour l’alimentation électrique et la communication
  • Raccordement par câbles, y c. chemin de câbles dans l’espace de circulation, et remplacement de l’éclairage de traversée existant à l’échangeur de Zurich-Nord (y c. fourniture, montage et mise en service des points lumineux)
  • Démantèlement des départs électriques des candélabres d’éclairage routier déjà démontés
  • Extension des ensembles d’appareillage à basse tension pour départs électriques supplémentaires de différentes dimensions
  • Équipements des puits à câbles
  • Retrait des câbles inutilisés dans la conduite à câbles et les puits à câbles

title: TECHNOLOGY LICENSING OPPORTUNITY: DC Recruiter
description: DC Recruiter: Broad-Spectrum Immune Enhancer from scientists at Los Alamos National Laboratory offers a differentiated approach to multi-pathogen infection prevention by using a self-assembling peptide nanofiber to recruit and activate dendritic cells (DCs), the immune system�s natural sentinels. Unlike pathogen-specific vaccines or therapeutics, it is designed to help trigger an early immune response regardless of the infecting agent. Its needle-free, spray-friendly concept adds practicality. The Challenge: DC Recruiter addresses a persistent and highly consequential gap in infection management: the need for a rapid, broadly effective way to stimulate immune defense before the specific pathogen is known. In many exposure scenarios, the body encounters a threat before clinicians can identify the cause, and that delay can reduce the effectiveness of conventional interventions. Current vaccines, antibiotics and antivirals are generally designed to act against a known target, which limits their usefulness when exposure is unexpected, diagnosis is delayed or the pathogen is unfamiliar. That limitation creates a clear unmet need for a fast-acting, broad-spectrum approach that can be deployed early, with minimal complexity, and in settings where rapid response matters most, including outbreak situations, field environments and other high-risk conditions. Problems Solved: DC Recruiter solves this problem by using a specific peptide selected to bind to dendritic cells. By leveraging a self-assembling peptide nanofiber platform, the technology is designed to help �wake up� immune surveillance early, before infection can progress unchecked. Rather than relying on a treatment matched to one virus or bacterium, it creates the potential for broad-spectrum immune support across many different infectious threats. Its ability to provide broad-spectrum immune support makes it especially compelling for situations where time is critical and conventional options may be too specific, too slow or too late to provide immediate protection. The needle-free, spray-friendly concept also adds practical value by supporting easier administration and broader accessibility, strengthening its fit for real-world use cases that demand rapid, flexible deployment. Key Advantages: Helps the body respond faster after exposure to an infection Works in a broad, pathogen-agnostic way rather than against just one germ Targets dendritic cells, which help alert and activate the immune system May be useful when the exact cause of infection is not yet known Could be helpful in outbreak, emergency, or high-risk settings Has the potential to be easier to use because it is designed as a needle-free spray Market Applications: Infectious Disease Prevention (early-response immune support, broad-spectrum protection) Outbreak Response and Public Health (rapid deployment, exposure mitigation) Defense and National Security (force protection, biological threat preparedness) Consumer Health and Wellness (easy-to-use immune support, potential spray format) Pharmaceuticals and Biotech (next-generation immunomodulation, platform development) Emergency Preparedness (first-response tools, high-risk exposure settings) Development Status: TRL 3 US Patent pending LA-UR-26-24915 LANL Tech Partnerships: Unlock the Innovative Potential Los Alamos National Laboratory offers a wide range of cutting-edge technologies and capabilities that may provide your company with a competitive edge in the market and unlock the innovative potential that can enhance, refine, and revolutionize your products. TECHNOLOGY LICENSING OPPORTUNITY: Bacterial Lipid Nanodiscs Platform
description: The Bacterial Lipid Nanodiscs Platform developed by Los Alamos National Laboratory provides a new way to study entire bacterial membranes in a controlled, nanoscale format derived directly from native lipid extracts. Researchers gain access to membrane components that typically remain difficult to isolate, stabilize or analyze, enabling more accurate evaluation of immunogenic lipids and membrane?associated targets. The platform offers a safer alternative to handling live high?risk pathogens while preserving the biological context that drives meaningful insights for vaccine design and antimicrobial discovery such as therapeutic antibodies to conserved lipids on bacterial membranes. How it Works The Bacterial Lipid Nanodiscs Platform creates uniform nanoscale discs from total lipid extracts harvested from bacterial membranes. Membrane scaffold protein MSP1D1 encases the lipid mixture and forms a stable disc roughly 10 nanometers wide. The resulting particles retain the full complement of native bacterial lipids, arranged in a membrane?like environment that supports realistic biological interactions without requiring synthetic lipids or live cells. Technical Description The method adapts established nanodisc assembly techniques to incorporate entire bacterial lipid extracts rather than defined synthetic lipid mixtures. Total lipids from a pathogen are solubilized, combined with MSP1D1 and dialyzed under controlled conditions to allow the scaffold protein to form a discoidal structure around the heterogeneous lipid population. The process yields nanoparticles that represent the membrane environment of the source organism, including amphiphilic molecules that typically resist purification or structural study when isolated from their native context. The approach was demonstrated using Yersinia pestis, chosen to illustrate how membrane characterization can proceed without the hazards associated with live Tier 1 pathogens. The method captures lipopolysaccharides (LPS) and diverse immunogenic lipids in an arrangement that mirrors their natural organization. Researchers can evaluate binding interactions, immune?stimulating properties and potential antigenic targets in a stable platform that avoids the limitations of outer membrane vesicle purification. Furthermore, using this platform we have identified antibodies specific to E. coli LPS and Y. pestis membrane lipids. These antibodies are independently licensable. Advantages � Provides membrane?like structures using native bacterial lipids � Avoids the safety challenges of handling live pathogens � Offers a broader and more realistic lipid environment than synthetic nanodiscs � Enables improved assessment of membrane antigens and immune responses � Supports analysis of diverse bacterial species using a unified workflow � Creates consistent nanoscale particles suitable for research and development settings Market Applications � Life Sciences Research (membrane biology, immunology) � Vaccine Development (bacterial antigen discovery) � Drug Discovery (membrane?associated targets) � Diagnostics (lipid biomarker exploration) � Biodefense Research (safe pathogen characterization) Development Status: TRL 3 U.S. Patent pending LA-UR-26-24920 LANL Tech Partnerships: Unlock the Innovative Potential Los Alamos National Laboratory offers a wide range of cutting-edge technologies and capabilities that may provide your company with a competitive edge in the market and unlock the innovative potential that can enhance, refine, and revolutionize your products. LANL�s licensing program focuses on moving inventions developed by our researchers to commercial innovations. Patented and patent pending inventions and copyrighted software are available to existing and start-up companies through exclusive and non-exclusive licensing agreements. For specific discussions, please contact licensing@lanl.gov. Note: This is not a call for external services for the development of this technology. https://www.lanl.gov/engage/collaboration/feynman-center/partner-with-us/licensing-technology m.lanl.gov/tech-search

title: Belgium – Repair and maintenance services of building installations – Raamovereenkomst: Technisch onderhoud, herstelling, uitbreiding en vernieuwing van de HVAC-installaties van het provinciaal patrimonium
description: Provincie Limburg wil voor het technisch onderhoud, en de hieraan verbonden herstellingen, van de HVAC-installaties van de gebouwen van het provinciebestuur Limburg overgaan tot het opstellen van een raamovereenkomst. De raamovereenkomst wordt afgesloten voor de duur van 4 jaar. Deze raamovereenkomst heeft als doel te voorzien in: Deel 1: Wettelijk verplicht onderhoud - uitgevoerd door het eigen personeel van de opdrachtnemer (met de vereiste erkenningen) of erkende keuringsorganismes. - een jaarlijks nazicht van de stooktoestellen op stookolie en op gasvormige brandstoffen. - voor de koeltoestellen zal de dienstverlener ervoor zorgen dat de verplichtingen inzake onderhoud en nazicht worden nageleefd. - de dienstverlener staat in voor een dichtheidsmeting van de gasleidingen. Deel 2: Preventief onderhoud - bijkomend onderhoud bovenop de wettelijke vereisten, dat op regelmatige tijdstippen of op basis van de bedrijfsuren dient te gebeuren met als doel: - het bevorderen van de levensduur van de installaties; - het voorkomen van gevaarlijke toestanden; - het voorkomen van storingen en defecten; - het energieverbruik zo laag mogelijk te houden. Deel 3: Correctief onderhoud - onderhoud dat uitgevoerd wordt wanneer defecten zich voordoen: - storingen en defecten herstellen binnen de overeengekomen tijd; - de prijs voor de wisselstukken wordt bepaald op basis van een verhogingspercentage; Deel 4: Deelopdrachten - uitvoeren van werken in het kader van afbraak, vernieuwing en/of uitbreiding van technische installaties: - per deelopdracht wordt een afzonderlijk dienstbevel gegeven, waarbij aard en omvang van de werken, aanvangsdatum en uitvoeringstermijn worden opgegeven. Een eigen pv van vaststelling voor aanvaarding van de werken van de deelopdracht (deel-oplevering) zal worden opgemaakt, conform de bepalingen van dit bestek; - op basis van een prijs per uur voor de werkuren; - de prijs voor de nodige materialen wordt bepaald op basis van een verhogingspercentage; - er kan geen minimum aantal werkuren noch een minimum bedrag aan deelopdrachten bepaald worden. Deel 5: Wisselstukken op basis van een verhogingspercentage - het bedrag dat jaarlijks wordt voorzien voor de nodige wisselstukken (preventief onderhoud, correctief onderhoud en deelopdrachten) wordt vastgelegd op € 100 000 exclusief btw. De combinatie van deze interventies heeft als doel: - het bewerkstelligen van de bedrijfszekerheid; - het garanderen van een veilige werking; - Het voorkomen van gevaarlijke situaties; - Het bevorderen van de levensduur van de technische installaties, d.w.z. er voor zorgen dat de installaties, gezien vanuit economische en/of technische overwegingen, zo lang mogelijk meegaan; - Het materiaal behoeden voor beschadiging; - Het voorkomen van storingen en defecten; - Het herstellen van defecten; - Het energieverbruik te minimaliseren; - Plaatsen en in dienst stellen van bijkomende HVAC-installaties via deelopdrachten.

title: Bravo Dive Boat 65DS1101
description: AMENDMENT 0005 POSTED 12/5. RFC #16 Response available in Attachments. AMENDMENT 0004 POSTED 12/3. AMENDMENT 0003 POSTED 11/26. AMENDMENT 0002 POSTED 11/21. AMENDMENT 0001 POSTED 11/19. The Regional Maintenance Center at Puget Sound Naval Shipyard & Intermediate Maintenance Facility (PSNS & IMF) intends to award a stand-alone Firm-Fixed-Price contract to accomplish the maintenance, repair, and preservation in support of one (1) 65 FT BRAVO DIVE BOAT 65DS1101. Work will be accomplished at the Contractor's facility. Geographical Area of consideration: To facilitate proper government oversight, the facility shall be located in the Puget Sound, WA region. For this procurement, the Puget Sound, WA region is defined as the West Coast of the continental US, starting from Olympia, WA and extending northward to Bellingham, WA. 65DS1101 Length: 69 FT 10 IN Width: 22 FT 0 IN Draft: 3 FT 6 IN Full Displacement: 55 L TONS Age: 13 YEARS Light Load: 8,000 lbs Hull Type: Aluminum Scope Overview: Coordinate with the Contracting Officer, via the Contracting Officer�s Representative (COR) to deliver the vessel to the Contractor�s facility from Puget Sound Naval Shipyard (PSNS) Bremerton, WA. Remove all fendering and sweep blast clean. Accomplish survey of hull to identify and repair corrosion, preserve the exterior above and below the waterline, including the crane. Apply nonskid to horizontal surfaces on the exterior and interior of the boat. Replace motor mounts. Remove, inspect and install shafting, rudders and propellers. HVAC repair. Maintain and repair watertight hatches and doors. Repair, modify and preserve push knee. Replace and modify corroded deck and bulkhead structure in the main cabin. Install remote fuel shut offs. Identify and repair corrosion beneath the transformers in the aft lazzarette, install a weather shield above the starboard transformer in the aft lazzarette. Replace hydraulic, and fuel hoses. buyer: Office des ponts et chaussées du canton de Berne
title: Projet global Burgdorf – Oberburg – Hasle, APPUI AU MAÎTRE D’OUVRAGE
description:
Dans le Bas-Emmental, les communes de Burgdorf, Oberburg et Hasle b. B. subissent depuis des décennies un trafic quotidien atteignant jusqu'à 20 000 véhicules. Cette forte fréquentation nuit à la qualité de vie et de séjour le long des axes routiers principaux et entraîne des temps de trajet imprévisibles, tant pour les transports individuels que pour les transports publics.


Avec le projet « Emmentalwärts », l'Office des ponts et chaussées du canton de Berne (OPC) a développé une solution globale visant à améliorer durablement la situation du trafic dans le Bas-Emmental.

Le projet global Burgdorf – Oberburg – Hasle (BOH) combine des contournements pour Oberburg et Hasle b. B. avec des mesures sur le réseau routier existant à Burgdorf et Lyssach. Le projet global se divise en trois tronçons – Burgdorf, Oberburg et Hasle b. B. – comprenant au total 19 mesures. Les coûts d’investissement s’élèvent à environ 424 millions de francs suisses. De plus amples informations sont disponibles sur www.emmentalwaerts.bvd.be.ch.


Le plan de route a été approuvé en janvier 2022 par la Direction des travaux publics et des transports du canton de Berne (Bau- und Verkehrsdirektion, BVD). Toutefois, en raison des recours déposés, ce plan n'est pas encore entré en vigueur dans l'immédiat. Avec le retrait des derniers recours à la fin du mois de mai / début juin 2026, le plan de route est devenu définitif. Le projet a ainsi franchi tous les obstacles juridiques et peut désormais être mis en œuvre. 


À la suite du review du projet global prévu à partir de 2027, les 19 mesures prévues dans les trois tronçons de Burgdorf, Oberburg et Hasle b. B. seront traitées dans le cadre des sous-phases SIA suivantes : projet d'exécution, appel d'offres et réalisation. Compte tenu du volume d’investissement d’environ 424 millions de francs suisses, du grand nombre de mandats de planification, de construction et de services à mener en parallèle, ainsi que de la durée pluriannuelle du projet jusqu’à sa mise en service, le maître d’ouvrage a besoin d’un appui continu et d’une coordination centralisée tout au long du projet. L’appui du maître d’ouvrage (AMO), en tant qu’organe d’état-major mandaté par la direction générale du projet, assure la gestion administrative et organisationnelle et soutient le pilotage du projet ainsi que les trois directions de tronçon. L’AMO accompagne le projet de bout en bout à travers toutes les phases restantes (y compris le review) et veille à ce que les coûts, les délais et la qualité soient gérés et documentés de manière uniforme pour l’ensemble des phases et des sous-projets, et présentés de manière transparente au maître d’ouvrage pour qu’il puisse prendre ses décisions.

title: Czechia – Construction work – Brno, Pekařská - rekonstrukce kanalizace a vodovodu
description: Předmětem veřejné zakázky je provedení rekonstrukce kanalizace a vodovodu, včetně kanalizačních a vodovodních přípojek, dále bude upraven celý veřejný prostor včetně modernizace tramvajové tratě, bude provedena kompletní obnova komunikací, parkovacích a odstavných stání, chodníků, včetně rekonstrukce veřejného osvětlení a trolejového vedení. Kanalizace a kanalizační přípojky: Kanalizace v ulici Pekařská pochází z let 1898 až 1901 a bude rekonstruována v celkové délce 680 m, z toho bezvýkopovou metodou (ve štole) v délce 146 m (v profilu DN 1000/1500 v délce 131 m a 500/750 v délce 15 m) a v otevřeném výkopu v délce 535 m (v profilu DN 1000/1500 délky 27 m, DN 800/1200 délky 430 m, DN 500/750 délky 61 m a DN 300 délky 16 m). Stávající kanalizace, které nebude při provádění stavebních prací vytěžena, bude zalita cementopopílkovou suspenzí. Zrekonstruovány budou rovněž všechny kanalizační přípojky ve veřejném prostranství o profilu DN 150 až DN 400 a v celkové délce 587,1 m a přípojky k dešťovým svodům v profilech KT DN 125 – DN 150 v celkové délce 279,5 m. Vodovod a vodovodní přípojky Bude provedena rekonstrukce vodovodu z tvárné litiny s těžkou protikorozní ochranou v celkové délce 881,7 m (v profilu DN 300 v délce 442 m, v profilu DN 250 v délce 269 m , v profilu DN 150 v dílce 170m). Po dobu stavby vodovodu bude náhradní zásobování vodou zajištěno prostřednictvím provizorního vodovodu z ocelových trub Ø 273x6,3 mm a délce 442 m a z ocelových trub Ø 219x8,0 mm v délce 269 m. V rámci stavby budou rekonstruovány vodovodní přípojky DN50, DN80 a DN100 v celkové délce 304,7 m. Hydrovrty V rámci stavby bude rekonstruovaná kanalizace v úseku Š953304 – Š7 a Š994565 – Š4 realizována za trvalého hloubkového odvodňování, a to soustavou hydrovrtů hl. 10 m a v počtu 29 ks. Rekonstrukce VO, přeložky sítí Součástí rekonstrukce ulice Pekařské je dále přeložka stávajícího veřejného osvětlení, dále přeložky sítí (CETIN, MU, Vodafone, T-mobile, FASTER, sdělovacích kabelů DPMB). Tramvajová trať Součástí stavby bude přeložka dvoukolejné tramvajové trati na velkoplošných železobetonových panelech s usazením žlábkové kolejnice NT1 a NT3, v úseku od křižovatky s ulicí Úvoz až po zastávku Šilingrovo náměstí. Součástí přeložky tramvajové trati je realizace 2 ks zastávek, 22 trakčních stožárů, přeložka trolejového vedení, kabelové sítě, přívodních kabelů ELP a přípojek NN pro ELP. Tramvajová trať bude realizována v celkové délce cca 653,50 m. Parametry pro obnovení kolejové dráhy musí plně respektovat vnitřní směrnice Dopravního podniku města Brna, a.s. (dále „DPMB“): • směrnice T07 „TECHNICKÉ PODMÍNKY PRO VÝSTAVBU, REKONSTRUKCE A ÚDRŽBU TRAKČNÍCH VEDENÍ DPMB“ v platném znění. • směrnice T08 „TECHNICKÉ PODMÍNKY PRO PROVOZ A ÚDRŽBU TRAMVAJOVÝCH TRATÍ DPMB“ v platném znění • směrnice T09 „TECHNICKÉ PODMÍNKY PRO VÝSTAVBU A REKONSTRUKCE TRAMVAJOVÝCH TRATÍ DPMB“ v platném znění. Tato směrnice stanovuje technické podmínky pro veškeré rekonstrukce a výstavbu nových tramvajových tratí, resp. kolejové konstrukce a křižovatky, které jsou ve vlastnictví DPMB, případně jsou připravovány a projektovány za účelem budoucího vlastnictví DPMB. Komunikace Součástí je rovněž rozsáhlé provedení celoplošné obnovy komunikačních ploch a chodníků o ploše 16 420 m2. Výstavba bude prováděna po ucelených částech. Podrobný rozsah prací na komunikačních plochách je popsán v dokladové části. Dále bude provedena rekonstrukce stávajícího světelného signalizačního zařízení (SSZ) křižovatky Úvoz – Pekařská. V rámci rekonstrukce bude také realizován mobiliář (lavičky, mříže ke stromům, odpadkové koše, zástěny na odpad, zahrazovací sloupky, stojany na kola, přístřešky MHD, pítka). Stavbu je nutné koordinovat s následujícími akcemi: • Rezidence Anenská brána (investor RUBELA, a.s.) dle Smlouvy o spolupráci při přípravě stavby uzavřené mezi Statutárním městem Brnem a RUBELA a.s. • Reko MS Brno – Pekařská (investor GasNet, s.r.o.) • D1 - Nový laboratorní objekt (investor FNUSA) Zhotovitel je povinen zajistit: • nepřetržitý přístup a příjezd vozidel IZS do Fakultní nemocnice u sv. Anny, • průjezdnost křižovatky Úvoz x Pekařská pro veřejnou dopravu viz POV, • nepřetržitý vjezd a výjezd na pozemek p.č. 1728, k.ú. Staré Brno, • u stavebních objektů SO 452 Sdělovací kabely MU, SO 453 Sdělovací kabely VODAFONE, SO 454 Sdělovací kabely T-MOBILE, SO 455 Sdělovací kabely FASTER a SO 456 Sdělovací kabely DPMB, objednatel upozorňuje na přísné podmínky jednotlivých vlastníků sítí elektronických komunikací. Zhotovitel je povinen zajistit přeložky a zabezpečení podzemních vedení sítí elektronických komunikací tak, aby za celou dobu realizace překládky nedošlo k přerušení provozu infrastruktury, s tím, že přerušení provozu infrastruktury u každého jednotlivého přepojení kabelů infrastruktury nesmí překročit 8 hodin. Podrobný popis rozsahu požadovaných prací je uveden v projektové dokumentaci „Brno, Pekařská – rekonstrukce kanalizace a vodovodu“, vypracované společností PK OSSENDORF s.r.o. Bližší informace viz Zadávací dokumentace.

Il s'agit d'un accord-cadre mono-attributaire, s'exécutant à la fois en part à prix forfaitaire (estimée à 47 543 335,00 € HT) et en part à bon de commande - sans montant minimum et avec un montant maximum de 12 000 000 euro(s) HT sur toute sa durée d'exécution. Conformément à l'article L. 2113-11 du Code de la commande publique, le pouvoir adjudicateur a décidé de ne pas allotir ce marché, aux motifs que l'établissement public n'est pas en mesure d'assurer par lui-même les missions d'organisations, de pilotage et de coordination et la dévolution en lots séparés risque de rendre techniquement difficile et financièrement plus coûteuse l'exécution des prestations.

title: Italy – Repair and maintenance services of mechanical building installations – Procedura aperta sopra soglia comunitaria, ai sensi dell'art. 71 del d.lgs. n. 36/2023 , articolata in n. 5 lotti, per l'affidamento del Global service per la gestione manutentiva degli immobili delle Sedi Regionali Rai Trentino, Veneto, Emilia-Romagna, Marche e Sicilia
description: Global service per la gestione manutentiva degli immobili delle Sedi Regionali Rai Trentino, Veneto, Emilia-Romagna, Marche e Sicilia, per una durata di 36 mesi con opzione di proroga della durata massima di ulteriori 24 mesi, da esercitarsi anche in via frazionata per un minimo di 6 mesi (durata massima 60 mesi). La prestazione richiesta riguarda l’esercizio e la manutenzione degli impianti elettrici, di riscaldamento, di ventilazione e condizionamento aria (HVAC), idrici sanitari e idrici antincendio, elevatori, rivelazione automatica incendi, controllo accessi, TV (rete visione interna), telefonici (TP) e trasmissione dati (TD), antintrusione e televisione circuito chiuso (TVCC), nonché del servizio di minuta manutenzione edile e del servizio di manutenzione delle aree verdi. Il servizio oggetto dell’affidamento prevede le seguenti prestazioni: a) manutenzione ordinaria (a canone) per esercizio degli impianti elettrici e HVAC impianti, dei componenti edilizi e delle aree verdi; presenza continuativa per esercizio e manutenzione degli impianti; b) manutenzione straordinaria (su richiesta Rai) afferente alle suddette attività; come descritto all’interno del Progetto di servizi. Non saranno previsti limiti alla partecipazione ai lotti né all’aggiudicazione di più lotti al medesimo operatore economico. Al fine di garantire la qualità del servizio, è prevista, ai sensi dell’art. 108, comma 7 del Codice, una soglia minima di sbarramento al punteggio tecnico pari a 35 punti. Informazioni e chiarimenti possono essere richiesti entro e non oltre il 03/12/2026 utilizzando l’area “Comunicazioni riservate al Concorrente”, presente nell’area di dettaglio della procedura. Le risposte alle richieste di chiarimenti sono fornite mediante pubblicazione delle richieste in forma anonima e delle relative risposte sulla Piattaforma nell’area “Comunicazioni della Stazione Appaltante”. È previsto il sopralluogo obbligatorio, da svolgersi dal 16/11/2026 al 27/11/2026 secondo termini e modalità previsti nel Disciplinare di gara. Saranno previste le seguenti fattispecie di modifica contrattuale, in tutti i lotti: - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 10 del Codice sarà prevista un’opzione di proroga della durata massima di ulteriori 24 mesi, da esercitarsi anche in via frazionata per un minimo di 6 mesi; pertanto, in caso di esercizio di detta opzione, la durata complessiva massima di ciascun contratto sarà pari a 60 mesi; in tal caso l’appaltatore sarà tenuto all’esecuzione delle prestazioni oggetto del contratto agli stessi prezzi, patti e condizioni previsti nel contratto; - in casi eccezionali, al verificarsi delle condizioni indicate all’art. 120 comma 11 del Codice, la durata del contratto base o di quello derivante dall’esercizio dell’opzione, ancora in corso di esecuzione, potrà essere prorogata per il tempo strettamente necessario alla conclusione della procedura di individuazione del nuovo contraente. In tal caso l’appaltatore sarà tenuto all’esecuzione delle prestazioni oggetto del contratto agli stessi prezzi, patti e condizioni previsti nel contratto; - ai sensi dell’art. 120 comma 1, lett. a) del Codice, Rai S.p.A. si riserva la facoltà, qualora l’importo contrattuale (del contratto “base” o di quello derivante dall’esercizio dell’opzione) non dovesse essere esaurito alla scadenza del termine di durata contrattuale, di estendere la durata del relativo contratto per il tempo necessario a poter utilizzare l’intero importo contrattuale; - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 1, lett. a) del Codice, Rai S.p.A. si riserva la facoltà di inserire od escludere dal contratto, in tutto o in parte (a titolo esemplificativo, per un immobile, per parte dell’immobile e/o per parte degli impianti e/o dei servizi), anche per limitati periodi, insediamenti che siano acquisiti e/o ceduti ovvero entrino o escano dalla disponibilità giuridica della Stazione appaltante ovvero siano oggetto di consistenti interventi di ristrutturazione, senza diritto da parte dell’Aggiudicatario ad alcuna indennità o altra forma di riconoscimento economico, fermo restando il versamento dei corrispettivi per le prestazioni regolarmente eseguite sino alla data della modifica. A riguardo, l’Aggiudicatario prende atto ed accetta che il Servizio dovrà essere eseguito con continuità anche in caso di eventuali variazioni delle consistenze e della dislocazione delle sedi e degli immobili oggetto di manutenzione. La valutazione economica di tali modifiche/varianti avverrà facendo riferimento ai corrispettivi contrattuali. In particolare, il canone sarà proporzionalmente adeguato, tenuto conto della incidenza delle parti escluse/incluse e/o del periodo di esclusione dalla manutenzione, sulla base delle informazioni contenute nel Capitolato tecnico e relativi allegati; - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 1, lett. a) del Codice, Rai S.p.A. si riserva la facoltà di apportare modifiche al contratto durante il periodo di efficacia ove si verifichino scostamenti di tipo tecnologico nelle consistenze individuate all’interno della documentazione di gara, ed in tale evenienza il canone sarà proporzionalmente adeguato, tenuto conto della incidenza degli scostamenti verificatisi; - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 1, lett. d) del Codice, Rai S.p.A. si riserva la facoltà, in corso di esecuzione, di sostituire l’aggiudicatario iniziale con un nuovo contraente nei seguenti casi: a) risoluzione del contratto per eccessiva onerosità sopravvenuta della prestazione ai sensi del Codice civile; b) risoluzione del contratto per impossibilità sopravvenuta ai sensi del Codice civile. In tali circostanze, la sostituzione potrà interessare solo soggetti che hanno partecipato alla presente procedura alle condizioni proposte dall’operatore economico interpellato secondo le modalità di cui all’art. 124 del Codice.

title: Germany – Works for complete or part construction and civil engineering work – Totalunternehmerleistungen (TU+) für den Neubau Campus Großhadern des LMU Klinikums, 1. Bauabschnitt
description: Das zur Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München gehörende LMU Klinikum (LMUK) zählt mit seinen beiden Münchner Standorten Campus Großhadern und Campus Innenstadt zu den führenden medizinischen Universitätsklinika in Deutschland und Europa. Das LMU Klinikum umfasst 29 Fachkliniken, zwölf Institute und sieben Abteilungen sowie 50 interdisziplinäre Zentren. Fast alle Disziplinen sind am Campus Großhadern vertreten. Da in der derzeitigen baulichen Struktur des Campus Großhadern die Bildung räumlich zusammenhängender Zentren nicht realisierbar ist, muss der Campus daher neu gebaut werden. Der erste Bauabschnitt des Neubaus beinhaltet die Errichtung folgender Bauteile inkl. der Außenanlagen: 1. Diagnostikum (DIAKUM) mit ca. 14.600 m² NUF, 2. Herz,- Lungen- und Gefäßzentrum (HLG) inkl. Hubschrauberlandeplatz mit ca. 25.800 m² NUF, 3. Onkologisches Zentrum (ONKO) inkl. Sonderisolierstation (SIS) mit ca. 25.700 m² NUF. Des Weiteren umfasst der erste Bauabschnitt auch die bauliche und technische Erschließung des Neubaus. Die Ausschreibung der Totalunternehmerleistungen erfolgt in 3 Losen. Los 1 betrifft das Diagnostikum (Diakum), Los 2 betrifft das Herz-Lungen-Gefäß-Zentrum (HLG), Los 3 das Onkologische Zentrum (ONKO). Zusätzlich haben die Bieter in den Losen 2 und 3 die Möglichkeit, ein Angebot auf die Kombination der Lose 2 (HLG) und 3 (Onko) abzugeben.

title: Procedura aperta sopra soglia comunitaria, ai sensi dell'art. 71 del d.lgs. n. 36/2023 , articolata in n. 5 lotti, per l'affidamento del Global service per la gestione manutentiva degli immobili delle Sedi Regionali Rai Trentino, Veneto, Emilia-Romagna, Marche e Sicilia
description: Global service per la gestione manutentiva degli immobili delle Sedi Regionali Rai Trentino, Veneto, Emilia-Romagna, Marche e Sicilia, per una durata di 36 mesi con opzione di proroga della durata massima di ulteriori 24 mesi, da esercitarsi anche in via frazionata per un minimo di 6 mesi (durata massima 60 mesi). La prestazione richiesta riguarda l’esercizio e la manutenzione degli impianti elettrici, di riscaldamento, di ventilazione e condizionamento aria (HVAC), idrici sanitari e idrici antincendio, elevatori, rivelazione automatica incendi, controllo accessi, TV (rete visione interna), telefonici (TP) e trasmissione dati (TD), antintrusione e televisione circuito chiuso (TVCC), nonché del servizio di minuta manutenzione edile e del servizio di manutenzione delle aree verdi. Il servizio oggetto dell’affidamento prevede le seguenti prestazioni: a) manutenzione ordinaria (a canone) per esercizio degli impianti elettrici e HVAC impianti, dei componenti edilizi e delle aree verdi; presenza continuativa per esercizio e manutenzione degli impianti; b) manutenzione straordinaria (su richiesta Rai) afferente alle suddette attività; come descritto all’interno del Progetto di servizi. Non saranno previsti limiti alla partecipazione ai lotti né all’aggiudicazione di più lotti al medesimo operatore economico. Al fine di garantire la qualità del servizio, è prevista, ai sensi dell’art. 108, comma 7 del Codice, una soglia minima di sbarramento al punteggio tecnico pari a 35 punti. Informazioni e chiarimenti possono essere richiesti entro e non oltre il 03/12/2026 utilizzando l’area “Comunicazioni riservate al Concorrente”, presente nell’area di dettaglio della procedura. Le risposte alle richieste di chiarimenti sono fornite mediante pubblicazione delle richieste in forma anonima e delle relative risposte sulla Piattaforma nell’area “Comunicazioni della Stazione Appaltante”. È previsto il sopralluogo obbligatorio, da svolgersi dal 16/11/2026 al 27/11/2026 secondo termini e modalità previsti nel Disciplinare di gara. Saranno previste le seguenti fattispecie di modifica contrattuale, in tutti i lotti: - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 10 del Codice sarà prevista un’opzione di proroga della durata massima di ulteriori 24 mesi, da esercitarsi anche in via frazionata per un minimo di 6 mesi; pertanto, in caso di esercizio di detta opzione, la durata complessiva massima di ciascun contratto sarà pari a 60 mesi; in tal caso l’appaltatore sarà tenuto all’esecuzione delle prestazioni oggetto del contratto agli stessi prezzi, patti e condizioni previsti nel contratto; - in casi eccezionali, al verificarsi delle condizioni indicate all’art. 120 comma 11 del Codice, la durata del contratto base o di quello derivante dall’esercizio dell’opzione, ancora in corso di esecuzione, potrà essere prorogata per il tempo strettamente necessario alla conclusione della procedura di individuazione del nuovo contraente. In tal caso l’appaltatore sarà tenuto all’esecuzione delle prestazioni oggetto del contratto agli stessi prezzi, patti e condizioni previsti nel contratto; - ai sensi dell’art. 120 comma 1, lett. a) del Codice, Rai S.p.A. si riserva la facoltà, qualora l’importo contrattuale (del contratto “base” o di quello derivante dall’esercizio dell’opzione) non dovesse essere esaurito alla scadenza del termine di durata contrattuale, di estendere la durata del relativo contratto per il tempo necessario a poter utilizzare l’intero importo contrattuale; - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 1, lett. a) del Codice, Rai S.p.A. si riserva la facoltà di inserire od escludere dal contratto, in tutto o in parte (a titolo esemplificativo, per un immobile, per parte dell’immobile e/o per parte degli impianti e/o dei servizi), anche per limitati periodi, insediamenti che siano acquisiti e/o ceduti ovvero entrino o escano dalla disponibilità giuridica della Stazione appaltante ovvero siano oggetto di consistenti interventi di ristrutturazione, senza diritto da parte dell’Aggiudicatario ad alcuna indennità o altra forma di riconoscimento economico, fermo restando il versamento dei corrispettivi per le prestazioni regolarmente eseguite sino alla data della modifica. A riguardo, l’Aggiudicatario prende atto ed accetta che il Servizio dovrà essere eseguito con continuità anche in caso di eventuali variazioni delle consistenze e della dislocazione delle sedi e degli immobili oggetto di manutenzione. La valutazione economica di tali modifiche/varianti avverrà facendo riferimento ai corrispettivi contrattuali. In particolare, il canone sarà proporzionalmente adeguato, tenuto conto della incidenza delle parti escluse/incluse e/o del periodo di esclusione dalla manutenzione, sulla base delle informazioni contenute nel Capitolato tecnico e relativi allegati; - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 1, lett. a) del Codice, Rai S.p.A. si riserva la facoltà di apportare modifiche al contratto durante il periodo di efficacia ove si verifichino scostamenti di tipo tecnologico nelle consistenze individuate all’interno della documentazione di gara, ed in tale evenienza il canone sarà proporzionalmente adeguato, tenuto conto della incidenza degli scostamenti verificatisi; - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 1, lett. d) del Codice, Rai S.p.A. si riserva la facoltà, in corso di esecuzione, di sostituire l’aggiudicatario iniziale con un nuovo contraente nei seguenti casi: a) risoluzione del contratto per eccessiva onerosità sopravvenuta della prestazione ai sensi del Codice civile; b) risoluzione del contratto per impossibilità sopravvenuta ai sensi del Codice civile. In tali circostanze, la sostituzione potrà interessare solo soggetti che hanno partecipato alla presente procedura alle condizioni proposte dall’operatore economico interpellato secondo le modalità di cui all’art. 124 del Codice.

title: 8215 Utbetring av tilkomst til badestrand
description: Bakgrunn Fjaler kommune skal utbedre tilkomst til badestrand og toalett i Badevika, og utbedre turveg i Badevika. Målet er at det vert lettere for personer med funksjonsnedsettinger, inkludert bruk av rullestol og rullator, å bruke området. Dagens løysinger har begrensninger knytt til fremkommelighet, oppholdskvalitet og håndtering av terreng og overflatevann. Kommunen har derfor behov for tiltak som gir bedre adkomst, mer robuste utearealer og redusert slitasje på terreng og grøntareal. For leverandørene er det viktig å være kjent med at arbeidene skal gjennomføres i et eksisterende uteområde med terrengmessige utfordringer og med behov for praktiske, varige løsninger tilpasset lokale forhold. Anskaffelsen omfatter prioriterte delprosjekter, og det tas forbehold om at ett eller flere delprosjekter kan utgå avhengig av tilgjengelige midler og kommunens prioriteringer. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Anskaffelsen gjelder en entreprisekontrakt for opparbeidelse og utbedring av tilkomst og uteareal i Badevika. Leveransen omfatter nødvendige arbeider for å etablere funksjonelle og robuste løsninger for ferdsel, opphold og overvannshåndtering i området. Oppdraget er delt inn i tre delprosjekter og omfatter utbedring av tilkomst til toalett og badestrand, opparbeiding av oppholdsareal, utbedre veg ned i Badevika med tilhørende kvileplan og snuplass, og utbedring av eksisterende turveg. Arbeidene vil blant annet kunne omfatte grunnarbeider, masseutskifting, oppbygging av underlag, grøfter og rør for vannhåndtering, støttende konstruksjoner og etablering av ferdig dekke. Delprosjekt 3 er opsjon. Tilbudet skal derfor omfatte prisede delprosjekter og opsjoner. Entreprisen skal leveres komplett, inkludert nødvendige rigg- og driftsytelser, transport, massehåndtering og sikring av anleggsområdet i gjennomføringsperioden.

title: Finland – Architectural and related services – Itäkeskuksen joukkoliikenneterminaalin arkkitehtuurikilpailu
description: Pääkaupunkiseudun Kaupunkiliikenne Oy julkaisee arkkitehtuurikilpailua koskevan ilmoituksen Itäkeskuksen joukkoliikenneterminaalin arkkitehtisuunnittelusta Helsingin Joukkoliikenneinfra Oy:n ja Helsingin kaupungin liikenneliikelaitoksen (HKL) puolesta. Korttelialueella on tällä hetkellä Itäkeskuksen metroaseman sisäänkäynti, kaksi pysäköintilaitosta ja näiden kansitasolla bussiterminaali. Helsingin kaupunkistrategian 2025-2029 tavoitteiden mukaisesti Itäkeskusta kehitetään kunnianhimoisesti. Itäkeskuksen joukkoliikenneterminaalin uudistuksessa tavoitteena on luoda sujuvat vaihtoyhteydet eri liikennevälineiden välillä. Joukkoliikenneterminaalin suunnittelussa tavoitellaan viihtyisää, turvallista ja saavutettavaa kokonaisuutta. Hyvällä suunnittelulla halutaan varmistaa, että liikennevälineestä toiseen siirtyminen on helppoa ja sujuvaa ja tarpeelliset palvelut ovat lähellä. Uudistuksen myötä pikaraitiotie PR15 päätepysäkki sijoitetaan osaksi joukkoliikenneterminaalikorttelia. Kilpailun tavoitteena on luoda kaupunkikuvallisesti kiinnostavaa ja alueelle vahvaa identiteettiä luovaa ratkaisua. Kilpailu järjestetään yhteistyössä Helsingin kaupungin ja Suomen arkkitehtiliitto SAFA:n kanssa, liiton yleisesti käyttämien kilpailusääntöjen mukaisesti. Tarkemmat tiedot kilpailuohjelmasta, kilpailun verkkosivuilta. https://cc.tietoa.fi/c/itis-jlt Helsingin kaupungin liikenneliikelaitos ja Helsingin Joukkoliikenneinfra Oy tilaavat arkkitehtuurikilpailun voittaneelta taholta hankkeen pää- ja arkkitehtisuunnittelun, mikäli seuraavat edellytykset täyttyvät: - kilpailun voittajalla, tulevalla sopimuskumppanilla on tekijänoikeudet suunnitelmaan - kilpailun voittaja nimeää vähimmäisvaatimukset täyttävät kaksi henkilöä eli pääsuunnittelijan ja vastuullisen arkkitehtisuunnittelijan, voittaja voi myös itse toimia toisessa em. rooleista - tilaajat ja kilpailun voittaja pääsevät neuvotteluissa yhteisymmärrykseen sopimusehdoista ja suunnittelupalkkiosta (kattohinta ja tuntihinnat). Tehtävä käsittää seuraavien tehtäväluetteloiden mukaiset tehtävät: Hankesuunnittelu tehtäväluetteloiden kohdat B- D, Yleissuunnitelmat ja toteutuksen suunnittelu tehtäväluetteloiden kohdat E-G, Rakentamisen aikaiset ja takuuajan tehtävät tehtäväluetteloiden kohdat H-K. Tehtävä sisältää työturvallisuuslain mukaiset suunnittelijan velvoitteet sekä rakennustyön turvallisuutta koskevan asetuksen VNa 205/2009, 7§ mukaiset velvoitteet. Pääsuunnittelijaa ja vastuullista arkkitehtisuunnittelijaa koskevat vähimmäisvaatimukset: 1) Suunnittelijoilla tulee olla rakentamislain mukainen, oman alansa pätevyystodistus erittäin vaativalta tasolta. 2) Nimettävillä suunnittelijoilla tulee olla kokemusta vastaavan tyyppisestä ja laajuisesta hankkeesta hankkeen eri vaiheissa esimerkiksi matkustajaterminaalin, rautatieaseman, lentokenttäterminaalin, kauppakeskuksen tms. suunnittelusta, jossa on huomioitu suurien asiakas-, matkustaja- tai kävijämäärien hallinta. Kohteen erityislaatuisuuden vuoksi voidaan huomioida myös yli viisi (5) vuotta sitten valmistunut hanke. 3) Suunnittelijoilla tulee olla vähintään hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen suomen kielen taito. Neuvottelut toimeksiantosopimuksesta Neuvottelut aloitetaan viimeistään kolmen (3) viikon kuluttua kilpailun ratkaisemisesta, jolloin neuvotteluihin kutsutun tulee neuvottelujen alkaessa esittää tilaajille pääsuunnittelijan ja vastuullisen arkkitehtisuunnittelijan rooleihin ehdotetut, vähimmäisvaatimukset (1-3) täyttävät henkilöt hyväksyttäväksi. Neuvottelut käydään suomen kielellä ja sopimus laaditaan suomen kielisenä. Voittajan kanssa käydään neuvottelut kolmen (3) kuukauden aikana suunnittelukilpailun voittajan valinnan jälkeen. Tavoitteena tässä ajassa on saada molempien osapuolten hyväksymä näkemys sopimuksen ehdoista ja suunnittelupalkkiosta. Neuvottelujen jälkeen tilaajat tekevät hankintapäätökset toimeksiannosta. Toimeksiantosopimus laaditaan RT 80420 -sopimuspohjaan. Tilaaja laatii osapuolten väliseen neuvotteluun sopimusluonnoksen ja sen ehdot sekä sopimuksen liitteet. Sopimukseen liitetään mm. arkkitehtisuunnittelun tehtäväluettelo ARK18:n (RT 10-103253) ja pääsuunnittelun tehtäväluettelo PS18:n (RT 10–103254) soveltuvin osin sekä tietosuoja- ja salassapitoliite. Toimeksiannossa noudatetaan KSE 2013 ehtoja soveltuvin osin, ks. tilaajien esittämät liitteessä poikkeamat KSE 2013 ehdoista. Tilaajat varaavat mahdollisuuden tarkentaa ja täydentää poikkeamia koskevaa listausta tulevaan sopimusneuvotteluun. Tarvittavat kokoukset hankkeen eri vaiheissa sisältyvät tulevaan toimeksiantoon. Kokoukset täsmennetään tehtäväluettelojen mukaisesti sopimusneuvotteluvaiheessa. Hankkeessa käytetään projektipankkia, johon kaikki tuotetut dokumentit tallennetaan projektipankissa olevan ohjeistuksen mukaisesti. Hanke suunnitellaan tietomallipohjaisesti. Joukkoliikenneterminaalihankkeen edistäminen on ehdollinen sille, että tilaajat saavat tarvittavat päätökset hankkeen edistämiseen.

title: Global Distribution Expeditionary Contract
description: Update (12/18/2025): Redated Justification and Approval added to Special Notice - Amendment 0002. Update 2 (11/13/2025): Purpose of this action is to issue a second Justification and Approval to increase the contract ceiling. Update (9/30/2025) - Redacted Justification and Approval added to special notice. Initial: In accordance with FAR 6.302-1, the Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) anticipates awarding a modification to existing DLA Distribution Contract SP3300-21-D-5002 on a sole source basis to Olgoonik Federal, LLC. This contract provides labor to support workload surges, unforeseen/unplanned workload, contingency operations and special projects. The modification would increase the ceiling amount as the contract has been outpacing the anticipated spend rate. Pursuant to the exception under FAR 6.302-1(a)(2)(iii), only Olgoonik Federal, LLC is capable of providing the services at this time; award to any other source will result in unacceptable delays and would preclude DLA from reacting timely to requirements. This action could not have been overcome by advanced planning given the nature of this contract, which is to support unplanned, unforeseen requirements. If the contract ceiling is not increased to accommodate the known and anticipated requirements of this contract, as well as any unplanned requirements, DLA Distribution would not have a contract vehicle to provide services within the scope of this contract to support DLA and its customers mission. The modification to current contract SP3300-21-D-5002 will serve as a temporary solution to fulfill immediate mission requirements. A follow-on procurement is in process. The justification and approval for this ceiling increase will be posted as part of this notice once executed. This is not a solicitation for proposals or an invitation for bids. The Government does not anticipate receiving responses to this notice of a non-competitive action.

title: FY26 PROJECT WWXT240800 MULTI-PURPOSE APRON AND TAXIWAY, ROYAL AUSTRALIAN AIR FORCE (RAAF) BASE TINDAL, AUSTRALIA
description: This acquisition is for the construction (design-bid-build (DBB)) of aircraft pavements to support multiple airframes including aircraft parking apron and adjoining taxiway. Construction includes concrete aircraft parking and taxi area. Project will provide adequate concrete aircraft access apron and expansion and improvement of existing taxiway, including provision of all required pavement markings in compliance with Air Force Instruction 32-1042 and Engineering Technical Letter 04-02. Project will provide an access road and vehicle parking area to the rear of the aircraft apron. The work will include one (1) pre-priced option to construct; Option No. 1 is for bulk formation under future hangar zone. In accordance with FAR 52.217-7 Option for Increased Quantity � Separately Priced Line Item, the Government may exercise the option by written notice to the Contractor within 365 days of contract award. The magnitude of this project is estimated between $25,000,000 and $50,000,000. THE NORTH AMERICAN INDUSTRY CLASSIFICATION SYSTEM (NAICS) CODE IS 237310 AND AVERAGE ANNUAL RECEIPTS OF $45 MILLION OVER THE PAST THREE YEARS. THIS PROCUREMENT IS UNRESTRICTED. The contract completion period is anticipated to be 615 calendar days. This is a source selection procurement requiring the submission of both technical and price proposals. Proposals submitted in response to this solicitation shall be in the English language and in U.S. dollars. The Government intends to evaluate proposals and award a contract without discussions with Offerors (except clarifications as described in FAR 15.202(a)(2)). Therefore, the initial proposal shall conform to the solicitation requirements and should contain the best offer from a technical and price standpoint. Only the three (3) lowest-priced proposals will be evaluated for fair and reasonable pricing and technical acceptability. If none of the three (3) lowest-priced proposals are found to be technically acceptable, then all remaining proposals will be evaluated for fair and reasonable pricing and technical acceptability. The contract resulting from this solicitation will be awarded to that responsible Offeror whose offer, conforming to the solicitation, is determined to be the lowest evaluated price of proposals (within the funds available) meeting the acceptability standards for the technical evaluation factors. The following evaluation factors shall be used to evaluate the technical proposals. FACTOR 1: EXPERIENCE FACTOR 2: PAST PERFORMANCE FACTOR 3: SAFETY FACTOR 4: MANAGEMENT PLAN For Factor 1 Experience, a relevant construction project is defined as new construction of Airfield that includes at least one (1) of the following individual feature: New construction of Airfield Portland Cement Concrete (PCC) Pavement: New airfield (aircraft runway, taxiway, or apron) PCC pavement of at least 10,000 square meters with a minimum concrete thickness of 300 mm. Flexible pavement construction will not be considered when evaluating experience in Airfield PCC Pavements. Only pavement of aircraft runways, taxiways, or aprons will be considered. Projects submitted to demonstrate Airfield PCC Pavements will only be considered if the work was performed by the specific entity proposed for Airfield PCC pavements. Construction shall be completed or substantially completed no earlier than last fifteen (15) years from the date of issuance of this RFP. Substantially complete means at least 90% physically complete. New construction of Airfield Asphalt Concrete (AC) Pavement: New airfield (aircraft apron, taxiway, or runway) AC pavement of at least 10,000 square meters with a minimum asphalt concrete thickness of 50 mm. Airfield PCC pavement construction will not be considered when evaluating experience in Airfield AC Pavements. Only pavement of aircraft apron, taxiway, or runway will be considered. Projects submitted to demonstrate Airfield AC Pavements will only be considered if the work was performed by the specific entity proposed for Airfield AC Pavements. Construction shall be completed or substantially completed no earlier than fifteen (15) years from the date of issuance of this RFP. Substantially complete means at least 90% physically complete. Projects submitted shall collectively demonstrate experience in both individual features: (1) Airfield PCC Pavement and (2) Airfield AC Pavement. Individual features do not have to be within any single project scope. The Request for Proposal (RFP) is anticipated to be available on or around 13 October 2026. Please note that these dates (RFP issuance and response date) are estimates only and will be as shown in the RFP. Printed copies or CDs will not be issued. The RFP will be available on the SAM website. Amendments will be posted to the SAM website. It is the responsibility of the offeror to check the SAM website periodically for any amendments to the solicitation.

title: TECHNOLOGY LICENSING OPPORTUNITY: NanoFET
description: NanoFiber Engineered Therapeutics Platform (NanoFET) from Los Alamos National Laboratory offers pharmaceutical and biodefense organizations a modular, adaptable scaffold for building next-generation immunotherapies. By merging self-assembling peptide nanofibers with interchangeable nanobody and peptide components, the platform enables rapid development of targeted treatments that bridge disease agents directly to the patient�s own immune cells. Infectious diseases and chronic conditions such as cancer continue to impose enormous public health and economic burdens worldwide. Conventional vaccines and biologics are typically designed against a single pathogen or target, leaving populations vulnerable when new or unknown threats emerge. For military personnel and first responders, the absence of broad-spectrum medical countermeasures means that exposure to an unidentified pathogen in the field can be met with little more than supportive care. In cancer immunotherapy, connecting tumor cells to the patient�s own immune effector cells remains a formidable engineering challenge; current bispecific antibody formats are complex to manufacture, expensive and often limited in the number of targets they can engage simultaneously. Meanwhile, traditional antibody-based therapeutics are large molecules that can be difficult to produce at scale, may trigger unwanted immune reactions and lack the modularity needed for rapid adaptation to new disease targets. A platform capable of addressing multiple threats through a single reconfigurable architecture would represent a meaningful shift in how therapeutics are developed and deployed. Advantages: Modular architecture allows rapid swapping of nanobodies and peptides to address new disease targets without redesigning the core platform Dual-function capability bridges disease agents directly to immune cells on a single construct, enabling both targeted and broad-spectrum responses Adjuvant-free immune activation through self-assembling nanofibers that inherently stimulate robust, innate immune responses Small, stable targeting molecules (nanobodies) that are easier to produce and engineer than conventional full-size antibodies High-density multivalent display presents multiple antigens or functional components simultaneously, enhancing immune recognition Compatibility with external biologics enables partners to integrate their own AI-designed binders or proprietary targeting molecules onto the nanofiber scaffold Market Applications Oncology (bispecific T-cell engagers, tumor-targeted immunotherapies, combination immunotherapy platforms) Infectious Disease Therapeutics (pan-influenza treatments, broad-spectrum antiviral and antibacterial countermeasures, emerging pathogen response) Biodefense and Military Medicine (medical countermeasures for warfighters, rapid-response therapeutics for unknown biological threats, field-deployable immune enhancers) Vaccine Development (multiantigen vaccine platforms, adjuvant-free subunit vaccines, mucosal and systemic immunization) Pharmaceutical Biologics and Drug Delivery (nanobody-drug conjugate scaffolds, targeted immune cell delivery, modular biologic platforms) TRL 3 U.S. Patent pending LA-UR-26-25007 LANL Tech Partnerships: Unlock the Innovative Potential Los Alamos National Laboratory offers a wide range of cutting-edge technologies and capabilities that may provide your company with a competitive edge in the market and unlock the innovative potential that can enhance, refine, and revolutionize your products. LANL�s licensing program focuses on moving inventions developed by our researchers to commercial innovations. Patented and patent pending inventions and copyrighted software are available to existing and start-up companies through exclusive and non-exclusive licensing agreements. For specific discussions, please contact licensing@lanl.gov. title: M548 Metal Ammunition Containers Bridge Contract
description: The Government intends to award a 12 month bridge contract to Conco, Inc., under the authority of 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1), as implemented by FAR 6.302 Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. This action is for the production and delivery of approximately 9,000 M548 Metal Ammunition Containers, a critical packaging component for small and medium caliber ammunition used in training and combat operations. The bridge contract is necessary to ensure continued production and delivery of these containers until the anticipated follow-on contract is fully implemented. The proposed contract will be a firm-fixed-price 12 month bridge contract that mirrors the scope of work previously performed under the expired Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) Contract W52P1J-20-D-0033 with Conco, Inc. The estimated value of this effort is $616,964.60. The follow-on M548 Metal Ammunition Containers contract was awarded on September 25, 2025, with First Article Testing (FAT) due by June 23, 2026, and deliveries commencing in September 2026. However, immediate container deliveries are required in November 2025, January 2026, and April 2026. Extensive market research conducted on February 22, 2024, identified other potential vendors, but only Conco, Inc. can meet November 2025, January 2026, and April 2026 delivery timelines without unacceptable delays. Other vendors would require FAT and tooling modifications, resulting in a minimum delivery timeline of 12 months. Given Conco, Inc�s long history of successful M548 Metal Ammunition Containers production and the Government's agreement to waive FAT due to historically low risk of failure, it is determined that posting an additional Request for Information (RFI) or sources sought notice would not benefit the Government and would duplicate previous efforts.
